name: Fixes
author: byo-pop
description: Mends three faults of the original and changes nothing else: the time of a chamber is counted in the game's own updates instead of the machine's clock, the Ankh and Abandon Hope know what a fight between the mummies on the key stone does to the gate, and a tap of an arrow key that is over before the game looks never goes missing. Turn a fix off to play the original as it was.

settings.label: Chamber time counts game updates
settings.help: The original times a chamber by the machine's clock, so a slow moment or a pause costs bonus points. Here the time is the game's own updates, as the clock on the board counts it.

settings.label: Ankh knows the key-stone fight
settings.help: When one mummy beats the other on the key stone the gate flips, which the original's search leaves out, so the Ankh or Abandon Hope could be a turn wrong. Here the search counts it.

settings.label: A quick tap of an arrow key counts
settings.help: The game looks at the keys once every hundredth of a second, so a key pressed and let go in between is lost, which a key event sent by a program (a single press lasts a millisecond) never survived. Here such a press still moves the explorer. A press held as long as a hand holds it is unaffected.
